## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new flag should honor `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE`, as required by the CLI policy for CI configuration.

## Changes
The pull request adds repeatable `--exclude GLOB` filtering by filename, skip logging, flag documentation, and tests. This review read the tests without running them.

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read exclusion defaults from ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude`, `args.exclude` stays empty and `.log` files enter the archive. This violates “must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable” in `.agents/skills/cli-flags/reference.md:5`. — CI jobs that configure exclusions through the environment produce archives containing files they intended to skip.
